# ========================================
# SALTY TRANSPORT - Scripted GUIs (hand-written)
#
# Per-good partner-display entries live in the GENERATED file
# stl_scripted_guis_generated.txt; this file keeps only the generic ones.
# ========================================

# Tear down the partner breakdown (clear button in the trade window).
stl_sgui_clear_display = {
	scope = state
	effect = {
		stl_clear_display_lists = yes
	}
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	ai_is_valid = { always = no }
}

# Open the trade window for a state. Executed from the depot building panel:
#   GuiScope.SetRoot(GetPlayer.MakeScope).AddScope('stl_target_state', Building.GetState.MakeScope).End
stl_sgui_open_window = {
	scope = country
	effect = {
		set_variable = { name = stl_window_state value = scope:stl_target_state }
	}
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	ai_is_valid = { always = no }
}

# Close the trade window.
stl_sgui_close_window = {
	scope = country
	is_valid = {
		has_variable = stl_window_state
	}
	effect = {
		remove_variable = stl_window_state
	}
	ai_is_valid = { always = no }
}

# Does this state trade anything at all? (drives the window's empty-state text)
stl_sgui_has_trade = {
	scope = state
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = {
		variable_list_size = {
			name = stl_active_goods
			value >= 1
		}
	}
	ai_is_valid = { always = no }
}
